title: Donation Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=donation:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often donation metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on donation metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It finds how often your donation metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
